query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT created_at, id FROM sandboxes WHERE project_id = $1 AND name = $2 AND ((created_at, id) < ($5, $4)) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT created_at, id FROM sandboxes WHERE project_id = $1 AND name = $2 AND ($4 IS NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $6 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN sandbox_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
